shortDescription: New Zealand’s ruling National Party said it would widen access to low-deposit mortgages for first-home buyers if it wins November’s election, according to Bloomberg.The pledge would ease deposit rules for buyers seeking their first home.

title: New Zealand National Party Pledges Easier Low-Deposit Mortgages for First-Time Buyers
